tex_content.html: \begin{equation} |\nabla R(x,t)|<\eta R(x,t)^{3/2},\qquad \left|\frac{\D R}{\D t}(x,t)\right|<\eta R(x,t)^2, \end{equation} where the time derivative is one-sided at surgery points and $\eta $ is the constant from (3).
